e: The United States imposes a 10% tariff on Guatemala, citing the presence of alleged forced labor in the supply chain.
President Arevalo appoints Gabriel Estuardo García Luna as attorney-general effective 17 May.
A judge orders imprisoned journalist José Rubén Zamora to be placed under house arrest pending his trial on money laundering charges.
President Arevalo declares a 30-day state of siege in response to the killing of seven police officers by gangs in retaliation for rescue efforts by authorities in the prison uprisings.
Inmates stage coordinated uprisings in three prisons nationwide, resulting in 46 guards held hostage.
